clauses.title: CL-D82 records the gate launch's workspace and what it does not change
clauses.section: ## CL-D82 — The gate launch names the workspace its child runs in
requires: tetsuh/pi-tidd-agents#159
an `autofix` launch without the workspace is refused, and a `review-only` launch carrying one is refused, each at phase `build`
a clone fallback is retained and never entered
Those three screens are the whole of it, and what the builder judges is structure
The regression drives the installed pi-subagents over the built request, as CL-D81's does, and dropping that check requires a new owner decision
Requiring the workspace, supplying a cwd in review-only, or accepting a workspace the builder does not screen requires a new owner decision

clauses.title: The gate launch's workspace is pinned by its own regression
requires: Issue #159 a gate launch built with the created workspace runs in it
Issue #159 a review-only gate launch carries no cwd, and an autofix one may not omit it
Issue #159 a child sent to the workspace is given no path it must resolve there
Issue #159 the workspace must satisfy the declared shape, and an unusable path is refused
Issue #159 what the screens do not judge is stated, not assumed
Issue #159 the builder and the packaged CLI answer every CL-D82 path the same way
Issue #159 the parent cannot add a field to the built gate launch
Issue #159 the receiver accepts the cwd the gate launch now carries
Issue #159 the procedure states where each mode runs its gates
